svg.title: Piedmont study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Piedmont; 2: Barolo; 3: Serralunga d'Alba; 4: Barbaresco; 5: Asti; 6: Gavi; 7: Ghemme; 8: Carema; 9: Guacciorna; 10: Piano; 11: Milan; 12: Turin

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
